name: BCI Nanobot Pill
description: A swallowable bio-compatible capsule that releases localized neural nanobots into the brain. These nanobots assemble a fully integrated bio-computer inside the neural cortex, rendering all physical devices, screens, and terminals completely redundant.

name: Neural-Sync Telepathic Grid
description: Sub-dermal neural implants that sync with the colony's quantum mesh networks, allowing silent, high-bandwidth thought transmission across domes, bypassing audio clutter.

name: Helios-IV Deuterium Fusion Reactor
description: Miniature clean-fusion pods localized in each sector core, utilizing deuterium harvested from Martian polar ice. Provides 100% self-sufficiency to all auxiliary domes.

name: Geodesic Atmospheric Ionizer
description: High-altitude atmospheric ionization grids designed to generate localized magnetic micro-fields above Ares City, redirecting cosmic solar radiation away from structural glass domes.

name: Bio-Synthetic Oxygen Filters
description: Symbiotic cascade systems using genetically modified bioluminescent algae. Doubles the dome's botanical filtration capacity while providing warm, soft ambient lighting.

name: Quantum Warp Transit Pods
description: Sub-atomic teleportation pods utilizing quantum entanglement gates to warp small cargo and personnel between Ares City and deep space habitats instantly.
